tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dge 'dun bzang po sogs kyis sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed bzhugs// ༄༅/oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// chos kyi dbyings las nye bar byung zhing chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang tshul can// ji snyed gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa gsal zhing mkhyen bzhin 'gro ba'i don mdzad la// thugs rje'i thugs kyi rnam par brlan zhing rnam par grol ba'i 'bras stsol ba// rgyal ba rnam rgyal kun la 'dun zhing kun nas 'dud pas skyabs su mchi// zhi ba chags bral srid pa'i gdung ba sel zhing phun tshogs kyi// pha rol son byed bgrod pa gcig lam dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul ba// lung gi tshul dang mngon par rtogs pas rnam par bsdus pa'i chos rnams la// chos la nges pa'i 'dun pa dge bas dus rnams kun tu phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi tshul la chos bzhin zhugs pas chos nyid gzigs pa'i ye shes can// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i chos tshul rgya mtshos rgya cher gyur pa'i blo mnga' ba// rgyal sras rnams ni rang rang tshogs dang dgra rgyal bcas pa de bzhin du// chos kyi tshul bzhin zhugs pa'i tshogs la tshul bzhin gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar dkon mchog kun nas dge ba'i bka' drin mchog gi bde 'gro yi// mchog tu gyur nas ston pas bstan la bya ba byas pas 'jig rten dang*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal 'byor brnyes nas bstan pa 'gro la gsal mdzad pa// rab tu mang po 'jig rten 'di ni rnam par brgyan zhing dge bar mdzad// gangs can 'dir ni gangs kyi ri ltar rnam par dkar ba'i thugs mnga' ba// tshul bzhin sa skyong rgyal po dam pa tho tho ri dang de bzhin du// 'gro la thugs rje'i spyan ras gzigs pa srong btsan sgam po zhes bya dang*// mkhyen rab gsal bas 'jig rten gsal mdzad khri srong sde btsan zhes grags dang*// gsang bdag nyid bzhin bstan pa srung mdzad ral pa can la sogs pa yi// rgyal po rnams dang paṇḍi ta dang sgyur byed dam pa de dag gis// bstan pa rin chen bod kyi yul 'dir rgyas par mdzad nas bshes gnyen dang*// sbyin bdag rnams kyis bshad nyan bsgrub dang 'dri dang klog sogs tshul bzhin spyad// de dag rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas mdo smad smar klung sgang rar ni// rgyal po yab sras sku tshe ring zhing skye dgu thams cad bde legs phyir// hor gyi rgyal rabs lnga pa'i sku ring lcags mo lug gi lo la ni// chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa zhes grags pa de yi zhabs btud pa// dge 'dun bzang po rgyal po thar dang seng ge 'brug la sogs pa yi// sgang ri'i rigs gyur nye du dang bcas ban skye rnams kyi dad pa'i blos// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi 'jug ngogs mchog

/skye dgu rnams kyi bde ba'i gzhir gyur shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// stong phrag brgya ru rgyas par gsung dang stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa dang*// stong phrag brgyad du mdo ru bsdus rnams dri med rin chen gyis bzhengs te// rab tu gnas nas rgya cher mchod dang des gsungs bsgrags pa la sogs pa'i// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan gyis bdag cag rnams dang de bzhin du// dad ldan sgang ra je 'bum la sogs pha dang khu mes brgyud bcas dang*// ma dang phyi mo sogs kyis gtso byas mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa// srid pa kun tu srid zhi'i dpal la 'tshe ba med par longs spyod de// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med pa'i go 'phang dam pa thob par shog/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
